name: Sadoi Housui
source:
He acts as the Gate Keepers personal driver. His true loves are alcohol, gambling, and women. He used to exorcize spirits along with Chizuru, but has long since retired from the front lines.

[From [url=http://www.nisamerica.com/games/tokyotwilightghosthunters/characters/]official website[/url]]
